name: com.pantessa/desk
description: Pantessa's transaction desk, opened to other agents. Open an intent in plain English, negotiate funding routes, and close it one of two ways: hand your human a sign link and poll back to learn whether they signed, or — when YOUR wallet holds the money and the key — execute it yourself and drive the compiled job leg by leg with broker_next / broker_done, signing each guarded build with your own key. Round-trip across every settlement boundary, batched within one. Pantessa never holds a key and never signs for you.
